episodes.synopsis: Years has passed since Kenshiro disappeared following his final battle with Raoh and in the years since he's been gone, the Army of the Celestial Emperor has began to expand their territory through threat and oppression. Bat and Lin, Kenshiro's former companions, are now grown up and are leading a resistance movement known as the North Star Army.
episodes.title: The Past is Gone. The Dawn of the New Age!!

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious drifter wanders into a town where the remnants of the Red Dragon Party, a resistance movement that once opposed the Celestial Emperor's army in the past.
episodes.title: When Will He Awaken?!

episodes.synopsis: An innocent woman is mistaken for Lin and is sentenced for public execution by General Bask in an attempt to demoralize the North Star Army. The real Bat and Lin attempt to risk their lives until a familiar face arrives to intervene.
episodes.title: The Savior Comes From the North!!

episodes.synopsis: After being reunited with Bat and Lin, Kenshiro decides to join their cause, giving the North Star Army a needed boost in morale. A bounty is placed on Kenshiro's head and a man named Ein decides to take the offer.
episodes.title: The Mysterious Bounty Hunter, Ein! Kenshiro's Head is Mine!!

episodes.synopsis: As the North Star Army begins to liberate another one of the Celestial Emperor's areas, Kenshiro is forced to return to Mamiya's village to confront Solia of the Purple Light, a master of Gento Kōken who has been ordered to annihilate anyone associated with the Hokuto and Nanto schools.
episodes.title: Another Art of Assassination! The Imperial Fist of the Source Star is the Name!!

episodes.synopsis: While attempting to catch up with Bat and Lin, Kenshiro is confronted by Shoki of the Red Light, a man who once helped Kenshiro in the past, while Bat and Lin lead a desperate battle against the Golden General Falco, the strongest of the Gento warriors.
episodes.title: Rage of the Celestial Emperor! Falco, Obliterate the North Star from Earth!!

episodes.synopsis: Just when Falco is about to execute Lin in front of her supporters, Falco is challenged to combat by the Harn Brothers, Haz and Gil, who are seeking revenge against Falco for killing most of the Nanto Seiken masters, while Ein tries to lure Kenshiro to his traps.
episodes.title: The Wrath of the South Star! The Illustrious Harn Brothers!

episodes.synopsis: After Ein decides to switch sides and join the North Star Army, his former recruiter Beron decides to take revenge by kidnapping his "little lady", Asuka.
episodes.title: Ein in Danger! Hands of Evil Reach for His Love!!

episodes.synopsis: As Kenshiro and the North Star Army approaches the Imperial Capital, Shoki of the Red Light decides to revolt against the Viceroy Jakoh, who is holding the Celestial Emperor hostage and forcing Falco to do his evil bidding.
episodes.title: Falco, the Brave General of the Source Star! There Lies the Shadow of Raoh...

episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro confronts the renegade Gento warrior Boltz of the Blue Light, while Falco hands out a detonator to his lover Myu, which is triggered to destroy the foundation of the Imperial Capital, in case he loses to Kenshiro.
episodes.title: The Emperor's Cries Echoes Through the Imperial Capital. Falco, Where Have You Gone?

episodes.synopsis: Lin enters the Imperial Capital along with Bat and Lin, sensing that the Celestial Emperor is calling out for her, while Kenshiro and Falco begins their battle.
episodes.title: The Celestial Emperor is Finally Revealed

episodes.synopsis: Jako triggers bombs that collapse the ceiling of the cave in order to kill Lynn and Luise, but Ain shields with his body and protects the two sisters; weakened by the impact he still manages with his fists to open a gap and bring the prisoners to safety, but bleeding from the effort.
episodes.title: An Elegy for Ein! Die Bravely Than Live Without Honor!

episodes.synopsis: Lin and her group manage to escape from Jakoh's underground dungeon, but at the expense of Ein's life. With the Celestial Empress Lui now free, Jakoh loses his hold on Falco and begins to flee for his life.
episodes.title: The Fall of the Imperial Capital! Jakoh, You Can Dream in Hell!!

episodes.synopsis: Jakoh has been defeated, but Kenshiro must continue his journey when Lin is kidnapped and taken to the Kingdom of Shura, a country populated by ruthless warriors said to be the birthplace of the Hokuto, Nanto, and Gento arts. In order to reach Shura, Ken must cross the Sea of Death, the last remaining ocean on Earth.
episodes.title: The Ordeal Never Ends! Kenshiro Crosses the Ocean!!

episodes.synopsis: Having been taken to Shura by the Pirate Akasachi, Ken finds a dying Falco, who has traveled ahead to rescue Lin, while Lin is captured by Shura warriors and bribed off as a bride in a tournament.
episodes.title: What Awaits on the Continent of Darkness? There Lies the Legendary Land of Asura!!

episodes.synopsis: Ken faces Alph of the Hourglass, a Shura who has won 105 death matches in less than two minutes, while Lin is rescued by Shachi the Rakshasha, a master of the Hokuto Ryūken style.
episodes.title: Good or Evil? The Mysterious North Star Lapis Lazuli Fist Appears!!

episodes.synopsis: Shachi challenges General Kaizel, whose style allows him to remove an opponent's internal organs without leaving an open wound. Meanwhile, Kenshiro is taken to meet Shachi's former lover Leia, who preaches the value of love and friendship to the children of Shura.
episodes.title: Love is Preached in the Century's End! Her Name is Leia!!

episodes.synopsis: Shachi, in his plot to manipulate Kenshiro into destroying the Rashō, the three main rulers of Shura, begins taking Lin to the castle the third ruler, Han, who also practices the Hokuto Ryūken styles.
episodes.title: The General of Asura, Han! The Man Who Stains White Snow into Crimson!!

episodes.synopsis: As Kenshiro and Han begins their battle, Shachi tells Lin of how he began his Hokuto Ryūken training and the importance of Raoh's legacy to the commoners of Shura.
episodes.title: The Legend of the Savior of Asura! His Name is Raoh!!

episodes.synopsis: With rumors of Raoh's arrival to Shura spread as a result of Shachi's manipulation, Leia and her brother Tao goes to meet Jukei, the Hokuto Ryūken master who trained the three rulers and Shachi. Meanwhile, Han reveals to Kenshiro that the Kingdom of Shura is his birthplace.
episodes.title: Kenshiro's Secret is Revealed! The Land of Asura is His Motherland!!

episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro reflects on what happened since his arrival to Shura, as false rumors of Raoh's arrival are spread thorough the Land. A group "rags" led by a follower of Raoh named Kosem begins to raid a training cap in order to save his young son Chen and other children from indoctrination, unaware that the man who arrived overseas is actually Kenshiro.
episodes.title: A Cruel Prophecy! Kenshiro, You Cannot Be the Savior!

episodes.synopsis: Rock, Kosem's elder son, decides to carry on Raoh's legend along with his band of six cowboys to form the new Army of Raoh.
episodes.title: Rock, The Hero on Horseback! I Don't Believe in Kenshiro!!

episodes.synopsis: Rock is blackmailed by Gammon, the Scorpion Shura, into defeating Kenshiro in order to save a group of captured villagers.
episodes.title: Men Beyond Reasons! The Band of Seven Attacks Kenshiro!!

episodes.synopsis: Hyoh, the second ruler of Shura, decides to mobilize his force, vowing to avenge Han's death. Meanwhile Rock and his men decide to challenge Hyoh's army, having learned that Hyoh is Kenshiro's biological older brother.
episodes.title: Rock's Message of Death! Kenshiro, Hang on to Your Friend's Life!!

episodes.synopsis: Jukei seeks to restore Hyoh's memories of Kenshiro as his younger brother. Meanwhile, Kaioh, the supreme ruler of Shura, kidnaps Lin.
episodes.title: Announcing the Creator of the New Century! My Name is Demon Kaioh!!

episodes.synopsis: Jukei and Hyoh do battle. Kenshiro battles a squad of Shura warriors on his way to Kaioh's castle, where Lin is being held captive.
episodes.title: The Seal of the Devil! 2000 Year Tragedy of the North Star is Revealed

episodes.synopsis: Hyoh's battle with Jukei draws to a climactic conclusion as Jukei fails to restore Hyoh's memories, realizing that the seal put on Hyoh's memories was not his own, but Kaioh's. At the same time, Kenshiro is defeated by Kaioh and is taken captive.
episodes.title: Little Brother Ken in Danger! Hyoh, Open Up Your Kind Soul!

episodes.synopsis: After defeating Kenshiro, Kaioh plans on crucifying him in order to put an end to the Hokuto Shinken lineage. However,the plan falls through when Akashachi and his band of pirates come to Kenshiro's rescue. Shachi is revealed to be Akashachi's long lost son.
episodes.title: Kenshiro on the Execution Stand! The Heaven has Unleashed the God of the Sea!

episodes.synopsis: Following his father's death, Shachi attempts to escape with an unconscious Kenshiro while Akashachi's surviving men create a diversion to distract Kaioh.
episodes.title: Kaioh's Declaration of Victory! The Phantom of the North Star Attacks!!

episodes.synopsis: Lin meets Sayaka, Kaioh's sister and Hyoh's fiance, who hopes that someday Hyoh will bring peace to Shura and they will cross the sea together. Elsewhere, Shahci attempts to bring Kenshiro to safety when he has a chance encounter with Hyoh which results in Shachi sacrificing his own left eye as an offering for mercy.
episodes.title: A Destined Encounter of Hyoh and Ken! Both Are Yet to Know Their Secrets!!

episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro awakens at last when Cain, a Shura who seeks to succeeds the deceased Han as the third general, attacks at the waterfall. Meanwhile, Kaioh kills Sayaka and frames Kenshiro for her death.
episodes.title: Kaioh's Evil Decision! Cold Blood Runs Through My Body!!

episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro and Shachi go to meet up with Leia when they are confronted by a Gyoko, a morbidly obese Shura warrior who kills anyone who reminds him of his obesity. During this battle, Kenshiro declares war on Kaioh and all who side with him. At Sayaka's funereal pyre, Hyoh pledges eternal allegiance to Kaioh.
episodes.title: Kenshiro's Challenge! Never Be Defeated Twice!!

episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro and Shachi are taken in by Nagato, Hyoh's former right hand man, who turns against his master after he is corrupted by Kaioh's influence following Sayaka's death.
episodes.title: The Tyrant Hyoh and His Sorrowful Aide! Who Will Stop Him Now?!

episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro challenges Hyoh, now aware that they're biological brothers. Elsewhere, Hyoh is forcing slaves to work at Raseiden temple when he is confronted by Black Yaksha, a guardian of the Hokuto Sōke bloodline.
episodes.title: The Battle Of The Blood Brothers! Tears Will Never Return To Hyoh.

episodes.synopsis: The bloody battle between Kenshiro and Hyoh continues while Shachi and Black Yaksha look on in horror. Kaioh reveals his true identity to Lin as Raoh's biological brother.
episodes.title: The North Star on the Brink of Death! Kaioh Reaches Out for the Celestial Emperor!!

episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro's battle with Hyoh reaches its climax. However, Shachi stops the fight, and Hyoh suddenly regains his childhood memories of Kenshiro. The now reconciled brothers unite to defeat Kaioh.
episodes.title: Tearful Reunion of the Brothers! Kenshiro, I've Been Waiting for You!!

episodes.synopsis: In the aftermath of Kenshiro and Hyoh's battle, Shachi heads to Taiseiden temple to unlock the secret that could allow Kenshiro to defeat Kaioh. Meanwhile, Kaioh heads out to the holy temple himself to kill Shachi in revenge for interfering with Kenshiro and Hyoh's mutual destructions.
episodes.title: Shachi's Battle for Love! Kaioh Will Ridicule With Laughter

episodes.synopsis: In Taiseiden temple, a strange new discovery is made as Shachi makes a valiant last stand to defend Leia from Kaioh.
episodes.title: The Fall of Shachi, Warrior of Love! Love is Everything, My Friends!!

episodes.synopsis: When he and Kenshiro meet for their last fight, Kaioh remembers the death of his mother, which drove him to abandon all love and affection.
episodes.title: Tragic Victim of Love! Kaioh's Foundation of Evil!!

episodes.synopsis: Kaioh strikes a pressure point on Lin that causes her to fall asleep and fall in love with the first person she sees when she wakes up. Afterward, Kaioh and Kenshiro begin their final battle.
episodes.title: Kaioh's Disgraceful Past! The Heaven Recreate's Lin's Destiny!!

episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro and Kaioh's fight goes underground where Kaioh has the upper hand in a pit full of toxic gases. Hyoh rescues Lin from Samoto, a Shura warriors who plans to make Lin his wife.
episodes.title: The Final Chapter: The Last Three Episodes! Here is the 2,000 Year-old History of the Main Family of the North Star!!

episodes.synopsis: Accompanied by Black Yaksha, Hyoh is forced to fight Kaioh's elite army when Bat and the Hokuto Army arrive to assist them. Kaioh learns that he is descended from a branch of the Hokuto Sōke bloodline.
episodes.title: Prologue to the Final Episode! A Third Man Appears to Determine Lin's Fate!!

episodes.synopsis: Hyoh, Bat and Rihaku bear witness to the final battle between Kenshiro and Kaioh. When Kenshiro deals the winning blow, Hyoh is given the opportunity to finish Kaioh off, but cannot bring himself to kill the man he once called brother.
episodes.title: The Final Episode: Farewell, Kenshiro! Farewell, the Divine Fist of the North Star!!
